items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: So, when Buddy hired me to play at Lincoln Park, I was there about two Sundays.

ctx.x: Buddy Bolden, you mean? Yeah. No, Buddy Bottley. Bottley. Uh-huh. Don't get the Buddies mixed up. Well, didn't, didn't Buddy Bolden work at Lincoln Gardens?

Uh, Lincoln Park? Yeah. Yeah. He worked at that too. Well, I finished telling you. Uh, he was speaking about me at Lincoln Park. So, it was a woodland band, you know. So, when Buddy hired me to play at Lincoln Park, I was there about two Sundays. On the third Sunday, then I walked up to the place, I saw the sign up there on, on the boulevard, you know. You know, they'd buy a kid over here, you see. I said, see, where you get the idea of the kid? You know what the girls call you? You're the kid from now on. You…

Oh, that's the way you got the name. I always wished on him. Uh-huh. And it stuck. Well, why did the girls call you kid? Hmm? Why did they call you kid? Well, it's more young, you know. Honey, be honest.
